# Executing Your Service Menu — Here's The Play

• **Split it into two docs, not one** — Coaches need pricing, margins, upsell triggers, package bundling rules. Members need simple benefit language, no jargon. Different brains, different jobs. Use Google Docs so you can iterate live with your head coach and get real feedback before finalizing.

• **Anchor prices to your top 3 revenue drivers first** — Don't list everything. Identify which services (1-on-1 PT? Small group? Nutrition coaching?) actually move the needle for profit and member retention. Price those aggressively. Everything else becomes the "add-on shelf" around them.

• **Build in the friction point explicitly** — What's the actual decision tree? E.g., "Member joins → Standard membership = gym access only → Coach identifies her goal in week 2 → PT package upsell triggered → [price point]." Write the moment when the upgrade conversation happens. That's what matters operationally.

• **One rule for coaches: commission clarity** — If they're selling packages, they need to know exactly what they earn per conversion and what's bundled vs. à la carte. Ambiguity kills execution. Put it in the doc.

• **Go live with feedback loops** — Release to 3-5 trusted members and coaches this week. Ask: "Would you change anything here?" Iterate once, lock it, then roll out. Speed beats perfection.

Done in 5 days max?
